parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside under `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.7 indicates meaningful structural overlap between `PlaylistServiceCachingTests.loadsCachedPlaylistOnInit` and `PlaylistServiceTests.observerReceivesCachedDataDuringCacheLoad`, the two methods belong to distinct test classes (`PlaylistServiceCachingTests` vs `PlaylistServiceTests`) that appear to be testing different behavioural facets of the same service — caching-on-init vs observer notification during a cache load. Test methods with similar setup scaffolding but distinct assertions are intentional and should not be merged, as doing so would obscure test intent and make failure diagnosis harder.
